mcps.name: VAT Validator MCP
mcps.summary: A provider-hosted MCP service for EU, UK, and Australian VAT/registration checks and VAT-rate lookup.
mcps.installation: Connect an SSE-capable MCP client to the documented hosted endpoint; the repository does not document a local server setup.
mcps.deploymentModel: Provider-hosted SSE endpoint.
authentication: No credential documented for the free hosted endpoint
Provider billing/account relationship may be required above the free allowance
geographies: European Union
United Kingdom
Australia
mcps.pricing: The repository documents 50 free calls/month with no card, then $0.010 per query on pay-as-you-go billing.

capabilities.name: validate_vat
capabilities.summary: Validates an EU, UK, or Australian registration and returns provider risk analysis.

capabilities.name: get_vat_rates
capabilities.summary: Returns VAT-rate information for supported jurisdictions.

limitations: The repository combines authoritative registry checks with provider-described AI fraud analysis; the latter was not independently validated.
Hosted availability, retention, and billing behavior were not runtime tested.
The repository documents only two tools and an SSE endpoint.

test.notes: Repository and authoritative EU VIES landing page reviewed; no hosted endpoint connection or taxpayer lookup was performed.

mcps.name: Pipeworx Banking Regulations MCP
mcps.summary: A Pipeworx-hosted MCP adapter for searching and retrieving current U.S. banking and consumer-finance rules codified in 12 CFR.
mcps.installation: Connect an MCP client to the dedicated Pipeworx banking-regulations Streamable HTTP endpoint.
mcps.deploymentModel: Provider-hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint.
authentication: No credential is documented for the dedicated endpoint
Gateway plan limits may apply
upstreamProviders: U.S. Electronic Code of Federal Regulations, Title 12
geographies: United States
mcps.pricing: Pipeworx publishes gateway plans separately; the repository states no per-tool MCP price.

capabilities.name: banking_regulation
capabilities.summary: Retrieves current text for a named or cited 12 CFR banking rule.

capabilities.name: banking_regulations_search
capabilities.summary: Searches U.S. banking regulations by keyword and topic.

capabilities.name: subscribe
capabilities.summary: Shared gateway tool discovered at the dedicated endpoint; its write-oriented name is treated as state-changing and it was not invoked.

capabilities.name: remember
capabilities.summary: Shared gateway memory tool discovered at the dedicated endpoint; it was not invoked.

capabilities.name: regulatory_landscape
capabilities.summary: Shared regulatory-research prompt discovered alongside the banking tools.

limitations: Limited to U.S. federal rules in Title 12 and not a substitute for legal advice.
The dedicated endpoint's runtime catalog exposed 33 shared gateway tools and 12 shared prompts in addition to the two regulation tools.
Shared tools include write-oriented names such as subscribe, unsubscribe, remember, and forget; they were discovered but never invoked.
No regulation retrieval or legal-currentness audit was performed.

test.notes: Negotiated MCP 2025-03-26; discovered 33 tools, 0 resources, and 12 prompts. No tool was invoked.
